text:
olivia-sales: Heads up — NexaHealth POC ran into streaming failures during a stakeholder demo. The UI flagged JSON.parse errors and stopped updating.
leah-nexa: during the demo the stream produced fragmented JSON pieces, then the SSE connection dropped. Happened twice in ~5 minutes.
olivia-sales: quick timeline: demo start 14:32, first fragmentation 14:34, drop 14:35, retry 14:38 also saw partial frames.
max-eng: can you share the raw network body or our gateway logs? Need to confirm whether events are missing trailing blank line or if chunks were truncated mid-object.
leah-nexa: pasted the raw body; here's an excerpt:
```
event: response
data: {"req":"abc","delta":"Payment detai"
data: {"req":"abc","delta":"ls: card ****"}

# then socket closed
```
leah-nexa: you can see the first data line ends without finishing the word and the second data line resumes but the client still threw parse errors.
sam-sre: gateway logs show `write` errors from worker-3 around the same time: `write(): Broken pipe` and a prior `oom-kill` log 4m earlier. Also noticed a surge in CPU on that host from a background job.
priya-ml: if the generation process is OOMing mid-stream, the runtime can close the socket without emitting a well-formed terminal event, leaving the client with a half-formed event and no terminating `\n\n`.
kai-sdk: our browser SDK tolerates chunking but requires each SSE event to be terminated by a double newline. If the stream ends mid-event, JSON.parse fails. Short-term mitigation: buffer incoming `data:` lines until you detect `\n\n` before attempting JSON.parse, and add a small retry on parse failure. I'll draft a snippet.
max-eng: immediate infra mitigation: I'll bump worker memory reservation and disable the noisy cron that coincided with the spike. Starting a canary for worker-pool fix.
deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/worker-pool-memory-bump @1892504360. Canary nodes=2.
sam-sre: also enabling a generation-process watchdog: if the generator exits unexpectedly, emit an error SSE event `{\"error\":\"internal: generator died\"}` terminated with `\n\n` so clients get a clean close.
priya-ml: adding pre-write checks to the generator loop to avoid partial flushes: ensure buffer-boundary writes only after a complete JSON object is formed.
kai-sdk: demo-side quick fix: wrap parse in try/catch, append segment to a buffer and attempt parse again when more data arrives, fallback to a user-friendly retry UI if parse fails twice. I'll send a 4-line snippet for the sales team.
leah-nexa: thanks — we'll apply the client workaround to continue the demo if you can give an ETA for the infra fix.
max-eng: canary looks healthy after 4 test runs; no broken-pipe errors observed. Full rollout in ~7 minutes.
sam-sre: also added a Prometheus metric `sse_fragmented_events_total` and a Grafana panel. Alert rule at >5 in 5m for a pool.
olivia-sales: perfect — I'll tell NexaHealth to pause for 10 minutes and then retry the demo.
leah-nexa: retried after rollout and stream completed cleanly, no parse errors. Great response time from the team.
max-eng: follow-ups: (1) server guard to ensure event boundaries, (2) worker memory headroom increase and cron rollback, (3) generator watchdog to emit terminal errors, (4) SDK demo buffering snippet + sales playbook link, (5) alert on `sse_fragmented_events_total`.
kai-sdk: PR for the SDK snippet opened, linking it into the demo templates.
olivia-sales: closing once Nexa confirms stable POC runs. Thanks everyone :rocket:
